blogs.title: What Is FeatLLM – Why Turning GPT Into a Feature Engineer Matters
blogs.description: Discover how the novel framework FeatLLM rethinks tabular learning by letting an LLM write predictive rules from just a handful of labeled examples instead of forecasting every sample.

blogs.title: Crafting Rules With Language Models: The Two–Step Reasoning Process
blogs.description: See how careful prompt design asks an LLM first to infer causal links among columns based on prior knowledge, then use those insights plus a few examples to produce clean class–specific decision rules.

blogs.title: From Binary Rules to Accurate Predictions With a Tiny Linear Classifier
blogs.description: Learn why nine‐bit rule indicators fed into an inexpensive non‐negative linear model trained locally can beat heavy tree ensembles while staying fast during deployment.

blogs.title: Bagging Rules Makes Engineered Features Robust Against Weak Prompts
blogs.description: Find out how generating dozens of rule sets randomly (bagging) lets LaTering combine diverse weak learners into one strong predictor that survives long prompt limits and noisy columns.
